svg.title: From scene perception to robotic interaction

cc:Work.dc:title: From scene perception to robotic interaction
cc:Work.dc:description: A RoboCasa simulation frame with four numbered illustrative callouts matched to the literature branches: perception, functional understanding, reconstruction and generation, and manipulation and agents.

svg.title: From scene perception to robotic interaction
svg.desc: A survey map of articulated 3D research. Left: official RoboCasa simulator frame with illustrative vector annotations. Callout 1 identifies scene objects; 2 marks a cabinet hinge and opening motion; 3 outlines a microwave model; 4 shows a robot reach. Matching numbers and colors connect these examples to the four research areas and representative papers on the right. Annotations illustrate research questions and are not measured predictions or robot trajectories.
